scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start:db: (docker start dev-mongo-hqg 2>/dev/null || docker run --name dev-mongo-hqg -e MONGO_INITDB_DATABASE=hqg_dashboard -p 27017:27017 -v hqg-dashboard-mongo-data:/data/db -d mongo:7)
scripts.reset:db: docker rm -f dev-mongo-hqg && docker volume rm hqg-dashboard-mongo-data
scripts.start:db:ui: (docker start dev-mongo-express-hqg 2>/dev/null || docker run --name dev-mongo-express-hqg --link dev-mongo-hqg:mongo -e ME_CONFIG_MONGODB_URL=mongodb://mongo:27017/hqg_dashboard -e ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_USERNAME=admin -e ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD=admin -p 8081:8081 -d mongo-express:1.0.2)
scripts.prod: npm run build:frontend && npm run start:backend
